Slither (2006 film) is a 2006 science fiction comedy horror film written and directed by James Gunn in his directorial debut.
This Italian playwright and actor, who won the 1997 Nobel Prize in Literature, built much of his work on improvisation and the revival of commedia dell'arte — who was he?

Dario Fo (24 March 1926 - 13 October 2016) was an Italian playwright, actor, theatre director, stage designer, songwriter, political campaigner for the Italian left wing and the recipient of the 1997 Nobel Prize in Literature.

Named for a physicist who reportedly asked 'But where is everybody?' over lunch in 1950, this puzzle contrasts the vast odds of alien civilizations with our total lack of evidence for them — what's it called?
Fermi paradox is the term for the apparent gap between the lack of conclusive evidence of extraterrestrial civilizations and the apparently high likelihood of their existence.
